package.name: marine_vertical_datum
package.description: ROS-free vertical-datum resolution library (ADR-0010 D6): VDatum/PROJ grid queries (MLLW/MHHW relative to the WGS84 ellipsoid) plus the precedence-chain resolver (lake override, polygon config, VDatum, polygon fallback). Used by chart importers, CAMP display, and mru_transform's chart_datum_node.
